record.edic_text:
05827 `Ezer {eh'-zer}

from 05826;; n pr m

AV - Ezer 1; 1

Ezer = "treasure"
1) son of Ephraim who was slain by inhabitants of Gath
2) a priest who helped at the dedication of the walls of Jerusalem
   under Nehemiah
